name: text-scramble
title: Text Scramble
description: Scrambles characters on hover before settling back to the original text. Framework-agnostic Custom Element.

usage.label: React

props.name: text
props.description: The text content to display and scramble.

props.name: hover-target
props.description: CSS selector for an external element that triggers the effect. Defaults to this element.

props.name: scramble-duration
props.description: Duration of the scramble animation in seconds.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Delay between each character's animation in seconds.

props.name: cycles
props.description: Number of random character cycles before settling.

props.name: characters
props.description: Character pool to use for scrambling effect.
